Our Story

Built Out of Frustration.
Driven by Standard.

The UAE supplement and peptide market had a problem: too many stores selling unknown-origin products at inflated prices with zero support. Customers were guessing. We'd been there ourselves - receiving underdosed vials with no certificate, paying premium prices for powder from unknown sources.

Novu Peptides was our answer. We started with one rule: every product we carry must be something we would personally use and stand behind. That meant cutting through the noise - partnering only with brands that publish COAs, that invest in HPLC verification, that maintain cold-chain standards.

Today our catalogue spans 240+ products across 14 brands, covering everything from research peptides and GLP-1 compounds to elite sports nutrition and recovery supplements. The UAE now has a store that treats its customers as intelligent adults who deserve real information.

  • HPLC-tested, pharmaceutical-grade sourcing
  • Authentic stock with verifiable batch codes
  • Cold-chain handling for temperature-sensitive products
  • Same-day dispatch, COD across the UAE
  • Real humans on WhatsApp - not bots
